name: Sun Warrior's Guidance is a native spell modifier on Gavels and Dawnbreak (#993)
contract: Spell.dbc 800039 ("Sun Warrior's Guidance", SpellFamilyName 33, Passive) has one effect, SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) with EffectMiscValue 7 (SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE), EffectBasePoints 4 (amount 5), and EffectSpellClassMask word 2 = 1073745952. A repository-wide Spell.dbc scan for SpellFamilyName 33 spells whose own SpellFamilyFlags word 2 overlaps that mask returns exactly the Gavel of Light/Grace/Wrath and Dawnbreak spell chains (e.g. 800611 Gavel of Light Rank 1, 800654 Dawnbreak Rank 1) and nothing unrelated among the Radiant-Cascade family. Player::ApplySpellMod (Player.cpp:10219) is the fully generic native spell-modifier pipeline: it walks the player's SpellModifier list, and for a SPELLMOD_FLAT modifier does basevalue = basevalue*totalmul + totalflat, i.e. base 0 plus a single +5 flat modifier reads back as exactly 5. No server script exists or is needed; the DBC class mask alone attaches the bonus to the right spells.
